Application Data.NAME: Family Feast Restaurant
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Family-style full-service restaurant offering a diverse menu featuring American and international cuisines. We provide dine-in, takeout, and delivery services, ensuring a family-friendly atmosphere with ample seating for up to 150 patrons. Alcohol is served, with adherence to mandatory liquor liability coverage. Our operations include a kitchen fully equipped to handle high-volume food preparation, and we maintain strict hygiene and safety protocols. Delivery is conducted using our own vehicles, with commercial auto insurance in place. We do not rely on third-party delivery platforms for more than 50% of our sales, ensuring control over food handling and delivery safety.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 15, 2023, a fire broke out in the kitchen due to an electrical malfunction, resulting in damage estimated at $8,000. The incident was promptly contained, and there were no injuries, with the restaurant reopening within three days. The claim was settled, and the status is closed. Additionally, on September 10, 2022, a slip and fall incident occurred when a customer tripped over a wet floor in the dining area, leading to a claim of $2,000. This claim is currently pending, as the restaurant is working with the insurance adjuster to finalize the details.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras with 24/7 monitoring, fencing around the outdoor dining area, and hired security personnel during peak hours.
